title: Genomic characterization, in vitro, and preclinical evaluation of two microencapsulated lytic phages VB_ST_E15 and VB_ST_SPNIS2 against clinical multidrug-resistant Salmonella
journal: Annals of Clinical Microbiology and Antimicrobials
key_finding: Two lytic Salmonella phages (VB_ST_E15 and VB_ST_SPNIS2) were isolated from poultry markets, their complete genomes assembled by hybrid Illumina MiSeq and Oxford Nanopore sequencing (Flye/Medaka), and microencapsulated phage formulations demonstrated efficacy against MDR Salmonella in vitro and in a murine infection model.

title: Complete Genome Sequence of the Lysogenic Pseudomonas Bacteriophage Fyn8
key_finding: A temperate Pseudomonas aeruginosa phage isolated from river water was completely sequenced by Oxford Nanopore MinION at 589-fold coverage, yielding a 45,617 bp circular genome with lambda-like lysogeny regulators and putative O-antigen serotype conversion and anti-CBASS defense proteins.

title: Isolation, phenotypic characterization and comparative genomic analysis of 2019SD1, a polyvalent enterobacteria phage
key_finding: A novel polyvalent phage 2019SD1 with lytic activity against multiple enterobacteria including Shigella, E. coli, and Vibrio cholerae was isolated and its complete 53,145 bp circular genome sequenced via Oxford Nanopore GridION, placing it in genus Hanrivervirus of family Drexlerviridae.

title: Isolation and characterization of a novel bacteriophage WO from Allonemobius socius crickets in Missouri
key_finding: The first phage WO from North American crickets (Allonemobius socius) was isolated and its ~55 kb genome assembled using hybrid Oxford Nanopore MinION and Illumina sequencing, revealing structural proteins and eukaryotic-like host manipulation domains typical of Wolbachia phages.
